title: Intermittent Fasting on Body Fat and Quality of Life
official: The Effect of Intermittent Fasting on Body Fat and Quality of Life
summary: The purpose of this investigator-initiated study to check the feasibility that intermittent fasting has on body fat loss and quality of life.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• In good health

Exclusion Criteria:

• Diabetes or Metabolic Syndrome
